name: State Electronics Parts Corporation
old_description: is a broad line distributor of electronic components and hardware.
about:
State Electronics Parts Corporation, based in East Hanover, New Jersey, has operated as a broad-line distributor of electronic components and hardware since its founding in 1956. The company remains privately held, though ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The firm stocks and sells product lines from franchises including Honeywell Sensing and Control, Bourns, ETI Systems, Stego, and Mallory/Sonalert. In addition to distribution, State Electronics manufactures custom modular potentiometers under its Mod-Pots brand and is the sole source authorized by Honeywell to produce discontinued Honeywell potentiometer lines. The company also offers engineering-level support for product selection and technical inquiries.

Its customer base spans aerospace, defense, and space programs—evidenced by NASA-certified, hermetically sealed precision thermostats—as well as commercial, industrial, and military markets. The product portfolio includes snap-action switches, toggle assemblies, proximity sensors, pressure sensors, and audible signal devices.

State Electronics differentiates itself through its unique Honeywell authorization for legacy potentiometer production, dual ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100D certifications, and a sales team with deep technical experience in electronics distribution.

name: States Manufacturing Corporation
old_description: Same products. Same solutions. Now backed by the speed of Forgent.
about:
States Manufacturing Corporation operates from Champlin, Minnesota, in the Twin Cities metro area. The company was founded in 1924 by Anthony Shallbetter as States Electric Manufacturing Company and adopted its current name in 2010 to reflect broader capabilities. It remains a family-owned business led by Joe Shallbetter, Wyatt Shallbetter, Adam Frericks, and Bret Young, with deep community roots and a workforce that has stayed consistent through ownership transitions.

The company designs, engineers, and fabricates custom electrical equipment and precision metal products. Its capabilities span low-voltage and medium-voltage switchgear, panelboards, control cabinets, automatic transfer switches, generator connection cabinets, and electrical equipment shelters. In-house services include CAD-driven engineering, custom fabrication, painting and finishing, and equipment retrofits. The firm emphasizes end-to-end control from design through finishing, though specific facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed.

States Manufacturing serves a wide range of sectors including technology and data centers, telecommunications, healthcare (hospitals and clinics), industrial, mining, construction, marine, energy, utility, power generation, renewable energy, government, water and waste treatment, courthouses, sport facilities, stadiums, and parks. Customers range from data-center operators and utilities to contractors and OEMs requiring custom electrical enclosures and power-distribution gear.

The company positions itself as a problem-solving partner that takes personal pride in meeting challenging specifications with intelligently engineered, meticulously crafted products. It cites a commitment to using the latest technologies and state-of-the-art equipment while maintaining unchanging values of quality, safety, and integrity throughout each product's lifecycle.

name: Steel Creations & Fabrication, Inc.
old_description: Serving Phoenix, Arizona, with unique, high-quality ironwork!
about:
Steel Creations & Fabrication, Inc. operates from a shop in Glendale, Arizona, serving the greater Phoenix metropolitan area. The company does not publish a founding year, but its principals include Mike Stocker and Todd, who are cited in customer testimonials as the operation. The business began as a custom ironwork studio focused on one-of-a-kind steel designs for residential and commercial clients.

The firm fabricates custom gates—including courtyard, RV, yard, and vehicle-entry models—along with spiral staircases, residential and commercial fencing, commercial and interior railings, and security screen doors. Work is performed in-house by a team that includes CAD designers, welders, and installers; the shop handles design, fabrication, and installation without outsourcing core production.

Primary customers are homeowners and commercial property owners in the Phoenix area seeking bespoke architectural metalwork. Projects range from single courtyard gates to complete commercial railing systems, with each piece tailored to the building’s architecture and the client’s functional requirements.

The company positions itself as an alternative to mass-produced big-box components, emphasizing a consultative process that starts with an on-site visit to assess the property, understand the client’s goals, and then work backward to engineer a solution that integrates with existing design elements.

name: Steel House
old_description: KEEP YOUR PROJECT ON TRACK WITH QUICK TURNAROUND STEEL FABRICATION
about:
Steel House operates from Indianapolis, Indiana, as a steel service center, fabrication shop, and metal retail store. The company serves contractors, businesses, homeowners, and the construction industry with a focus on quick turnaround.

The shop provides a range of steel fabrication services including MIG, TIG, and stick welding; shearing with 3/8-inch and 1/2-inch hydraulic shears; hole punching up to 1-inch diameter; saw cutting on two horizontal band saws capable of 16-inch diameter; Nelson stud welding with same-day turnaround; CNC plasma cutting up to 2-inch thick plate; and press brake forming on a 250-ton machine that bends 3/8-inch plate in 10-foot lengths. Steel House also stocks a wide inventory of structural steel, decorative iron, pipe, tube, plate, and sheet, and operates six delivery trucks, some equipped with 63-foot cranes for rooftop or jobsite placement.

Customers include general contractors, commercial builders, and residential clients who need structural components such as columns, beams, handrails, dumpster gates, stairs, and pipe bollards. The company also supplies embed plates and perimeter angles for concrete construction, and provides CAD drawing support for plasma-cut parts.

Steel House differentiates itself with a walk-in showroom where light fabrication—cut, punch, form, or weld—can be completed while the customer waits, and with same-day or next-day delivery on stock material. The firm emphasizes rapid quoting, in-house CAD for plasma cutting, and a single-source model that combines material supply, fabrication, and installation.

name: Steel Jaw Fabricators
about:
Steel Jaw Fabricators is based in Beebe, Arkansas. The company does not publish its founding date or ownership details such as family, veteran, or woman-owned status.

The operation centers on a 20,000-square-foot fabrication shop and a dedicated 5,000-square-foot blast and paint facility. The firm offers a full design-to-install suite: design/build and detailing, reverse engineering, on-site visits for take-off measurements, on-site consultation, welding fabrication, installation, transportation, and expediting. In-house processes cover drawing and design, cutting, welding, casting, folding, painting, and delivery with installation.

Steel Jaw Fabricators targets industrial and commercial markets. Recent work includes structural steel assemblies, stainless-steel grating and walkways for a project in Charleston, South Carolina; cable trays and walkway supports destined for Ohio; and columns complete with base plates, gusseted feet, and cap plates.

name: Steel and Metal Service Center
old_description: From Iron-workers, Industrial Contractors to Weekend Warriors – Your One-Stop Shop for Metal, Welding, Hardware, and More!
about:
Steel and Metal Service Center operates from New Castle, Delaware, serving customers through its ShopMetal.com online platform. The company positions itself as a one-stop shop for metal, welding, hardware, and related supplies, catering to iron-workers, industrial contractors, and weekend warriors alike.

The business distributes a broad range of metal products including structural shapes (angles, beams, channels, flat bar, pipe, tube, sheet, and plate) in aluminum, galvanized, stainless, and carbon steel grades. Beyond raw metal, the catalog extends to welding consumables, safety equipment, hand tools, fasteners, material handling gear, and roofing and siding materials. A notable service is its point-of-use inventory management system, which uses smart bins with real-time visibility to automate replenishment for manufacturing and industrial operations.

Customers span automotive maintenance and towing, trailer component fabrication, pallet racking, marine and boating, concrete and masonry, cargo control, equipment construction, hand rail installation, and facility and grounds maintenance. The company also targets industrial contractors and DIY enthusiasts through its retail-oriented product assortment.

ShopMetal emphasizes priority customer service and a "Never Run Out. Always Restocked." promise, backed by its smart bin technology that aims to keep production lines moving without manual reordering.

name: Stello Foods, Inc.
old_description: Cart Error: Some items became unavailable. Update the quantity and try again.
about:
Stello Foods, Inc. operates from Punxsutawney, Pennsylvania, where it produces a line of specialty condiments, sauces, and preserves. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, nor are its founders named in available sources. The business centers on the Rosie's and Red Bull Inn brands, which encompass fruit spreads, pasta sauces, salad dressings, and mustards sold directly to consumers through its website.

The product roster includes Rosie's Strawberry Jalapeno Jam, Roasted Tomato Salad, Lasagna Sauce, Salsa Verde, Gnocchi Meat Flavored Sauce, and Hot Pepper Mustard, alongside Red Bull Inn Italian Dressing and The Old Colony Sauce. Stello Foods states that it uses the freshest produce, sourcing locally from Pennsylvania farmers whenever seasonal availability allows, and emphasizes that it cooks each batch with the same care it would for its own family. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are provided.

Customers span the continental United States, with testimonials citing orders shipped to Oklahoma and the Pittsburgh region. The company serves retail consumers seeking specialty pantry items not carried in local stores, as well as food-service operators such as concession stands — one review notes use in a football-game concession stand. A blog on the site offers recipe ideas, suggesting an audience of home cooks and entertainers.

Stello Foods positions its differentiation on local sourcing and hands-on cooking: "We use the freshest produce and source it locally from Pennsylvania farmers as often as they are in season! We take as much care cooking for you as we do our own family." This emphasis on seasonal, Pennsylvania-grown ingredients and small-batch preparation is the core of its stated value proposition.

name: StemWave of Bend
old_description: StemWave™ utilizes harmless, yet powerful acoustic waves to activate the body's natural healing mechanisms.
about:
StemWave of Bend operates in Bend, Oregon, under the direction of Dr. Jeff Finnigan. The clinic provides acoustic wave therapy treatments using the StemWave™ system.

The clinic delivers non-invasive, drug-free treatments that use acoustic waves to stimulate the body's natural healing mechanisms. Sessions last five to ten minutes and require no recovery time. Treatment areas include the neck and back, upper extremities such as shoulders, elbows, and wrists, lower extremities including knees, ankles, and feet, and soft tissues such as muscles, tendons, and ligaments.

Patients seek treatment for chronic aches, mobility limitations, and soft-tissue injuries. Testimonials on the site describe outcomes such as a return to walking eight miles after being unable to walk 100 yards, and regained ability to run up and down stairs.

The company emphasizes its FDA-listed status, the speed and affordability of treatments, and the absence of drugs or downtime as key differentiators.

about:
Sterling Molded Products operates from Middletown, New York, a suburb of New York City. The company was founded more than 30 years ago and has remained a privately held business; no founders are named in public records.

In-house capabilities include tooling and moldmaking supported by three CAD/CAM and CNC systems and EDM machines, as well as molding machine automation and robotics. The company also offers assembly solutions and full-service drop shipping.

Sterling serves customers in consumer products, cosmetics, toiletries, point-of-purchase displays, medical devices, and military products. The company does not disclose specific client names but positions itself as a supplier for both commercial and defense-related programs.

The company emphasizes domestic production at lower cost, rapid turnaround with parts shipped within 15 days, and quick quoting as its primary differentiators.
